content:
anya: Heads up, I ran the initial onboarding eval for buffon-embed-3B (float->int8 quant) on the retrieval holdout and recall@10 fell from 0.84 -> 0.72. Looking for quick triage ideas.
jon: Do we have centroid / norm drift numbers? quant often changes scale; maybe need per-dim clamp or L2 rescale.
anya: Good call. Attached quick stats: mean L2 norm (fp32) = 12.3, (int8) = 9.1. Pairwise cosine mean shifted ~ -0.06.
databot: automated-eval: run_id=buffon-3b-int8-2026-05-01, dataset=wiki-mini-holdout, recall@1=0.51, recall@5=0.68, recall@10=0.72, mAP@10=0.59, avg_query_time=9.4ms
maddy: Two immediate checks: 1) are you applying same normalization pipeline? i.e., tokenization + pooling + l2_norm. 2) try running HDBSCAN cluster stability vs KMeans — quant can collapse cluster borders.
ryan: Also check the ANN index params/version. We had a case where faiss IVFPQ+PQ params tuned for fp32 gave bad neighbors with quantized vectors. What backend did you use?
anya: Using hnswlib v0.7.0 with cosine, index-size ~250k vectors. Same index, just swapped in quantized model outputs.
jon: Two quick experiments: a) re-normalize int8 outputs to the fp32 norm distribution (multiply by mean_ratio ~ 12.3/9.1). b) try per-dimension affine calibration (learn scale+shift on small calibration set). Code to compute mean_ratio: ```python
import numpy as np
mean_ratio = np.mean(fp32_norms)/np.mean(int8_norms)
int8_rescaled = int8_vecs * mean_ratio
```
maddy: For clustering sanity, run silhouette score before/after rescale and also compute nearest-neighbor label flip rate (how many top-1 neighbors changed label). Those are more sensitive than recall.
anya: Quick rescale run results: recall@10 improved to 0.78 (from 0.72). silhouette mean +0.04. nearest-neighbor flip rate dropped 12% -> 6%.
jon: That's promising — suggests global scale mismatch is major. Still, per-dim drift might account for residual gap. If rescale lands us close, consider adding a lightweight per-request L2 rescale in the serving path for the canary.
databot: canary-rollout-check: model=buffon-embed-3B-int8, canary=5%, baseline=buffon-embed-3B-fp32, metric=recall@10, last_run=1739998881, status=not-yet-deployed
ryan: Before canary, let's do an index rebuild with int8 vectors (don't reuse fp32 index). That avoids PQ/centroid mismatch. Rebuild cost ~15m for this dataset.
anya: I'll queue a rebuild and run a small per-dim calibration using 5k calibration pairs. Also will run faiss baseline for comparison.
jon: If index rebuild + rescale closes >90% of gap, schedule canary with traffic split and automatic rollback policy if recall@10 drops >0.03. Example rollout config: ```yaml
canary: 5%
metric: recall@10
rollback_if: drop > 0.03 for 10k queries
```
maddy: One more note — test with noisy translations and punctuation changes; we've seen quant degrade robustness on short queries. Add short-query subset to eval.
anya: Added noisy-short subset (1k queries). After rescale+index-rebuild: recall@10 (short) = 0.65 (vs fp32 0.71). Still a gap but much better.
deploy-bot: CI: index-rebuild job queued (job_id=ix-2026-173999, est_time=12m).
anya: Thanks all — action items: I will run per-dim affine calibration + full index rebuild, document rescale as interim mitigation, and open a canary rollout PR with rollback rules. Will post results in this thread when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
